title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face, and within this face, draw a single loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates [0.0469, 0.0469] and a radius of 0.0469. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0937. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion forms a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of 0.09375, a width of 0.09375, and a height of 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base circle
circle_center = (0.0469, 0.0469)
circle_radius = 0.0469

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
extrude_scale = 0.0937

# Perform the extrusion operation
r = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth, taper=extrude_scale)

# Display the final model

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469)  # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
